issues.title: Missing concurrency/race condition handling for localStorage
issues.why: The FOUC-prevention script in §00 and AC-038 handles storage blocking but doesn't address potential race conditions if multiple tabs or scripts attempt to mutate the 'theme' key simultaneously during initialization.
issues.fix: Add a window 'storage' event listener to the bootstrap script to sync theme changes across tabs instantly.

issues.title: Truncated Typography Spec
issues.why: The file 03-typography.md is truncated due to the 136KB context cap, leaving H4-H6 and specific prose spacing rules undefined for the coder.
issues.fix: Move the normative Typography scale table from 03-typography.md into the §00 Overview Canonical Registry section.

issues.title: Missing timeout/fallback for Google Fonts
issues.why: The spec mandates specific fonts (Ubuntu/Poppins) but does not define behavior if the Google Fonts CDN is unreachable or times out, beyond a generic CSS fallback.
issues.fix: Add a requirement for a font-loading timeout script that applies a 'fonts-loaded' class to the body to prevent layout shift.
